items.title: NEWS #01 · Meta Andromeda 2.0
items.caption:
NEWS #01 · Meta ka Andromeda 2.0: aapka ad kise dikhega? 📢
Meta ne ad chunne wala system badal diya. 3 badlaav:
1️⃣ Speed: ek server pe har second 100 crore+ ads check, pichhle version se 100x
2️⃣ Har eligible ad ko score, har insaan ke liye sabse fit ad
3️⃣ Meta ke hisaab se 2025 se Facebook conversions +2.4%. Koi nayi setting nahi, apne aap.
Matlab: ek hi ad ke 10 version nahi, alag-alag angle chahiye.
✅ Har creative mein alag baat: problem, review, use, comparison
✅ Har hafte 2-3 naye angle
✅ Targeting itni tight nahi ki system ke haath bandh jaayein

items.title: CASE #04 · Pehle order pe loss, phir bhi profit?
items.caption:
CASE #04 · Pehle order pe loss, phir bhi profit? 📦
Naya customer: ad kharcha ₹400, order se bachat ₹250 → pehla order −₹150
Wapas aaya (WhatsApp se, bina ad):
Order 2 → +₹250 · Order 3 → +₹250
Total: +₹350 (example numbers)
Wapas nahi aaya? Sirf loss.
Rule: pehle order ka loss tabhi sahi, jab customer wapas aaye.
✅ Delivery ke baad WhatsApp pe thank you
✅ Parcel mein agle order ka coupon
✅ Product khatam hone se pehle reminder

items.title: CASE #05 · Perfect 5-star rating, phir bhi sale kam?
items.caption:
CASE #05 · Perfect 5-star rating, phir bhi sale kam? ⭐
Research: log sabse zyada 4.0–4.7 rating wale product khareedte hain. 5.0 ke paas khareedne ka chance girne lagta hai, kyunki itna perfect fake lagta hai.
Aur 5 reviews wala product = 0 reviews wale se 270% zyada khareedne ka chance.
(Source: Spiegel Research Center, Northwestern University)
✅ 3-star review mat chhupao, achha jawab do
✅ Har product pe pehle 5 reviews laao
✅ Delivery ke 4 din baad WhatsApp pe photo wala review maango
Fake review? Kabhi nahi.

items.title: CASE #07 · Influencer ko ₹50,000, aaye 3 order
items.caption:
CASE #07 · Influencer ko ₹50,000 diye, aaye sirf 3 order? 😳
Matlab har order ₹16,667 ka pada. Galti influencer ki nahi, hisaab ki thi.
Maan lo product ₹999, saare kharche ke baad ₹450 bachte hain → ek order pe max ₹450 kharch kar sakte ho.
₹50,000 ÷ ₹450 = ~112 orders chahiye the fee wapas laane ko. Aaye 3.
(Example numbers)
✅ 1 bade creator ko ₹50,000 ki jagah, 10 chhote creators ko ₹5,000
✅ Har creator ko alag discount code ya link, taaki pata chale kaun bechta hai
✅ Jo video chala, creator ki permission lekar apne ad mein chalao

items.title: CASE #09 · Double price, phir bhi loss
items.caption:
CASE #09 · ₹300 ka maal, ₹599 mein becha. Double price, phir bhi LOSS? 📉
Maan lo ek order ka poora kharcha: product ₹300 + packing ₹25 + shipping ₹70 + payment fee ₹12 + returns ka hissa ₹40 + ad ₹200 = ₹647.
Price ₹599 → har order pe −₹48. Jitna zyada becho, utna zyada loss.
Sahi price = poora kharcha + profit → ₹647 + ₹150 = ₹797 ≈ ₹799.
(Example numbers, GST se pehle)
✅ Har order ka poora kharcha ek baar likho
✅ Ad ka kharcha per order bhi jodo (sab yahi bhoolte hain)
✅ Price nahi badha sakte? Combo se order value badhao
